SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] We've only been away for a short time, but this 
place already feels nostalgic.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] It's certainly a strange feeling.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So, let's head on over to your place.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh, aren't we parting ways here?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What do you mean? A boyfriend's gotta escort his 
girlfriend home, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eeh? B-Boyfriend... girlfriend... ehehe...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What are you getting so flustered about? You're 
making me embarrassed...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ehehe... Yeah, you're right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Come on, it's getting late. Let's go.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] We're home~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] We're back.

[FI] Gramps and Rock energetically rushed out of the 
house to greet us, with Grandma coming soon after.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
[FI] Ooh, you're finally back. We've all been twiddling 
our thumbs wondering, "Are they back yet?"

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're exaggerating...

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
[FI] Oh my, looks like we'll be seeing our great 
grandchild soon, Grandma.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANNY
TEXT:
[FI] Oh, I'm sure we still have a while to wait. They're 
just getting started.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
[FI] Ooh, that's right. Sowwy sowwy, I got a little ahead 
of myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I-I have no idea what you're talking about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Seriously, what's with this grand welcoming?

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
[FI] Don't play dumb, Kyou-chan. I was so worried that 
you won't be able to score points during your 
vacation.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
[FI] But, you guys seemed to be hitting it off really well 
on the second day... how far did you guys go?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] G-Grandpa?!

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
[FI] Good for you, Manami. Looks like we're having red 
rice tonight!

SPEAKER: SPK_ROCK
TEXT:
[FI] That's so friggin' awesome, Anchan! I hope I can be 
an aggressive guy like you one day!!

SPEAKER: SPK_ROCK
TEXT:
[FI] In fact, I've always totally wanted a big brother like 
you! Yeah! Sweet!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] They sure are excited...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Hey, wait a second Gramps! How do you know all 
that?

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
[FI] Nothing to it, I've been watching over you from the 
heavens above.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You don't mean... you actually followed us all the 
way to Kyoto?!
[FI] This old geezer's done something outrageous...

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: [FI] Well, it's your fault for not noticing, Kyou-chan.

[FI] So, this was his plan all along, offering us this Kyoto 
vacation...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Grandpa, you followed us because you were 
worried?

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
[FI] Of course I was worried about you two. I steeled 
myself with a resolve to watch over you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What a load of bull...

[FI] Steeled yourself? You're acting more like a 
mischievous fox. Maybe a Kappa...

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANNY
TEXT:
[FI] This old man thought it would be interesting to 
stalk the two of you. That's all.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT: [FI] Grandma, you're too blunt.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] *sigh*... Well Gramps, thanks to you we were able to 
have a nice vacation, so... whatever, it's fine. Anyway, 
we bought some souvenirs.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANNY
TEXT: [FI] Oh, you really shouldn't have.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, I guess I better be on my way.

SPEAKER: SPK_ROCK
TEXT: [FI] Hey, Anchan, you wanna stay over?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No, I've got some souvenirs for my family, so I 
gotta get home.

SPEAKER: SPK_GRANDPA
TEXT:
[FI] Oh, I was hoping to hear all about your adventures. 
You sure are cold, Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You know, I doubt there's a need to tell Gramps 
about the vacation, all things considered.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well then, excuse me.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan, let me walk you home.
[FI] Manami follows me out the door.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hey now, I just finished escorting you back home 
and now you want to do the reverse?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Hehe, that did happen, huh? But you know, I just 
feel like doing that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] It's just up to that point... okay?.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Geez, you're so pushy. Just up to that point then.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...Hey, Kyou-chan. You'll be with me forever, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Of course. I... I realize how much I care for you, 
and... I can't imagine myself with anyone else.
[FI] It's rare for her to ask things like that.

[FI] Looks like Manami got a little bolder thanks to our 
little trip.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I love you, Manami.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Me too, Kyou-chan. I love you, too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Manami...
[FI] We confirm our feelings with our lips.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Nn... chu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] We'll always be together, Manami.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, together... Kyou-chan.

[FI] After this, we kiss for a long while, as if renewing 
our vows.

[FI] Spending these ordinary days... with the person I 
love-
